other formal: datatype 'a tree = Leaf | Node "'a tree" 'a "'a tree"

formal function definitions.height:
fun height :: "'a tree ⇒ nat" where
  "height Leaf = 0" | "height (Node l a r) = max (height l) (height r) + 1"
formal function definitions.min_height:
fun min_height :: "'a tree ⇒ nat" where
  "min_height Leaf = 0" | "min_height (Node l _ r) = min (min_height l) (min_height r) + 1"
formal function definitions.complete:
fun complete :: "'a tree ⇒ bool" where
  "complete Leaf = True" | "complete (Node l x r) = (height l = height r ∧ complete l ∧ complete r)"

formal theorem statement: theorem complete_iff_min_height: "complete t ⟷ (height t = min_height t)"
